question: Which word in the given sentence is the ANTONYM of – **Jeopardy**?
solution: The correct answer is **'safety'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Jeopardy**__**: Danger of being damaged or destroyed (नष्ट होने का खतरा****)** __ • **​E.g.__**- The lives of thousands of birds are in **jeopardy** as a result of the oil spill. • __**Safety**__**: The state of being safe (सुरक्षित रहने की स्थिति****)** __ • **​E.g.__**- New **safety** measures have been introduced on trains. **​**Hence, the correct answer is **'safety'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Leave**__**: To go away from somebody/something (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से दूर जाना****)** __ • **E.g.**__- We should **leave** now if we’re going to get there by eight o’clock. • ​__**Relative**__**: When compared to somebody/something else (किसी अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से तुलना करने पर अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति, वस्‍तु; सापेक्ष****)** __ • **​E.g.__**- The position of the earth **relative** to the sun. • ​__**Reluctant**__**: Not wanting to do something because you are not sure it is the right thing to do (कोई विशेष कार्य करने का अनिच्‍छुक)** __ • **E.g.__**- She had trouble sleeping but was** reluctant** to take sleeping pills. 3f:T55d, The erroneous part is: **called me**.
